latestVersion.changelog:
AI Tool for Video Editing — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release offering AI-driven video editing and export using cloud GPU nodes.
- Supports uploading raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and natural language instructions for editing.
- Provides automatic session/token management with 100 free credits for new users.
- Handles edit requests, exports polished 1080p MP4s, checks balance/status, and more.
- Integrates error handling for common issues (file size/format, credits, tokens).
- Designed for fast, professional video edits with minimal setup required.
